channel.title: Epic Sidekick Updates
channel.description: Updates for the complete Epic Sidekick Lightroom Classic plug-in.

item.title: Epic Sidekick 1.0.0 (767)
item.description:
Clean Sweep now finishes the rest of a batch when Lightroom times out on a Generative Remove result. If Lightroom displays a blocking alert, dismiss it and the batch continues automatically.
When the batch finishes, Clean Sweep opens the affected photos together in the Needs Review collection. Confirmed edits stay in Processed Photos. Clean Sweep leaves each unconfirmed removal available for inspection and skips it during the rest of the batch.
